title: Choose a copy mode
caption: Select Card for camera-card ingest or Folder for general folder copies; each mode keeps an independent settings profile.

title: Prepare a direct session
caption: Add one source and one or more destinations, confirm the naming preview, and check preflight before starting.

title: Stage mixed queued jobs
caption: Queue separate Card and Folder jobs when different sources need different destinations or post-copy settings.

title: Build a relay chain
caption: For A to B to C, order destinations fastest first and use Queue Relay Chain so each downstream leg waits for verified upstream output.

title: Set post-copy actions
caption: Use the Post-Copy tab to configure confirmation, contact sheets, metadata, HTML trees, proxy media, and destination sorting for Card or Folder mode.
